## Device
- Request: new device / correction / additional evidence
- Model, manufacturer and hardware configuration:
- Stable device ID, if already listed:

## Proposed changes
For each field, give the current value, proposed value, unit and scope.
Preserve inequalities, ranges, display regions and assembly details.

## Evidence
For each source, supply the URL, exact quotation, supported field, page/section,
and actual access or capture date if known. Attach unhighlighted source captures
and optional highlights below. Do not fabricate missing metadata.

## Reason
Explain why the proposed record or correction is supported.

## Review
- [ ] I understand that submissions are proposals requiring maintainer review.
- [ ] I have preserved the source wording and parameter scope.
